instruction.name: movgr2scr
instruction.description: Copy the value in rj to the scratch register selected by scrd (0-3).

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: movgr2scr $scr0, $r4; movgr2scr $scr1, $r5; movgr2scr $scr2, $r6; movgr2scr $scr3, $r7; movgr2scr $scr0, $r8; movgr2scr $scr1, $r9; movgr2scr $scr2, $r10; movgr2scr $scr3, $r11
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 10000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'movgr2scr $scr0, $r0; movgr2scr $scr1, $r0; movgr2scr $scr2, $r0; movgr2scr $scr3, $r0' --asm 'movgr2scr $scr0, $r4; movgr2scr $scr1, $r5; movgr2scr $scr2, $r6; movgr2scr $scr3, $r7; movgr2scr $scr0, $r8; movgr2scr $scr1, $r9; movgr2scr $scr2, $r10; movgr2scr $scr3, $r11'
throughput.notes: 8 instructions take 8.01 cycles: 1.00 cycle per instruction.

notes: LBT scratch register move. The movgr2scr + movscr2gr round trip is 4.01 cycles and only the sum is observable; there is no separate handle on either direction, so no per-direction latency is recorded.
